newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Ibusz says ticket, currency sales helped profits.
newsitem.headline: Ibusz says ticket, currency sales helped profits.

text.p: The Hungarian travel group Ibusz Rt said in its earnings report on Monday that increased ticket sales, currency exchange income and sales tax refunds for tourists at its Ibusz Utazasi Irodak Kft subsidiary helped it swing to a profit in 1996.
The group reported consolidated pre-tax profits of 40.5 million forints in 1996 compared to a loss of 292.2 million in 1995.
Currency exchange revenue grew by 190 percent as the company opened new exchange bureaux, the report said without indicating either the 1995 or the 1996 figures.

The sales tax refunds for travellers who take goods purchased in Hungary out of the country jumped 300 percent in 1996 while ticket sales expanded 175 percent, the report said, once again without indicating the 1996 or 1995 turnover in these markets.

In other matters, the report added that the drop of consolidated sales revenues to 4.02 billion forints in 1996 compared to 5.46 billion in 1995 is mostly the result of Ibusz selling its stakes in various subsidiaries, the report said.
They included Toyota Tsusho Kft and Mediterran Tours Kft, it added. - - Blaise Szolgyemy, Budapest newsroom (361) 327-4040
